title: Warden Mace by HexaFoxx
description: Warden Mace adds a new mace recipe and ability, create a warden beam dealing a lot of damage with a 15 second cooldown. YOUR offhand bind to toggle.
body:
Harness the terrifying power of the Ancient Cities with the Warden Mace. This high-tier tactical weapon translates the Warden's signature ranged biological attack into a player-controlled tool for devastating precision. Designed for 1.21.11 PaperMC, it offers a high-risk, high-reward combat style for elite warriors.

Weapon Overview
The Warden Mace allows you to project raw sonic energy across the battlefield. By utilizing your offhand bind (Default: F), you can instantly trigger a concentrated beam that pierces through defenses and strikes targets at a distance.

Core Mechanics
Sonic Boom Projection: Activating the ability fires a Sonic Beam that travels up to 20 blocks.

Immersive Visuals & Audio: The ability is paired with authentic Sonic Boom particles and the bone-chilling Warden sound effects.

Rapid Recharge: Features a 15-second cooldown, allowing for frequent use in fast-paced skirmishes.

BossBar Tracking: A dedicated Dark Aqua BossBar appears at the top of the screen to track your ability readiness in real-time.
